integrity: Original mathematical extension derived from and citing the already published finite-dimensional mean closure and generator. Exact proof and reproducibility scripts are included. Self-review only; no independent priority or correctness audit.
scientific_limitations: Finite one-dimensional hard-core chain, a symmetric positive definite two-species diffusivity matrix, a physical anti-aligned-gradient reservoir family, and the specified constitutive mean species current including both reservoir links. Other parameters, tracer crossing counts and fluctuation processes are not classified.
title: Sharp finite-chain cutoff for partial uphill current in symmetric two-species exclusion
